Who can apply for a Two Sigma internship?
jobs.description: For our engineering internship roles, we accept undergrads entering junior or senior year of college, masters students, and PhDs pursuing a degree in a technical or quantitative field. For our quantitative research internship roles, you should be pursuing a degree in a technical or quantitative discipline, like statistics, mathematics, physics, electrical engineering, or computer science with approximately one year remaining in your program (all levels welcome, from bachelor’s to doctorate). Mor

jobs.title: Do I need a finance background to intern at Two Sigma?
jobs.description: It’s nice to have, but more than half of Two Sigma’s employees come from outside the finance industry. If you’ve got the quantitative skills and a passion for the problems we’re solving, we can teach you the rest.

jobs.title: When should I apply for a summer internship at Two Sigma?
jobs.description: As early as possible. We post our internship applications the summer/fall prior to the program, and recruit on campus during the fall season. We receive tens of thousands of applications for our internship program, so we recommend submitting one as early as you can.

jobs.title: What should I expect from the Two Sigma internship interview process?
jobs.description: Our interview process consists of a combination of technical and behavioral interviews - both to assess your technical abilities and also see what you’d be like to work with.

jobs.title: Are Two Sigma internships paid, and is housing or relocation support available?
jobs.description: Yes, we pay a competitive salary and provide corporate housing for interns for the duration of the program. We do offer relocation support.

jobs.title: What are the perks and benefits I’ll get as an intern?
jobs.description: You'll be interning at our New York headquarters, located in the vibrant SoHo neighborhood. Our NY office features onsite fitness centers with group classes and laundry service, fully stocked kitchens (with complimentary lunch a few times a month), game rooms, meditation spaces, a Hacker Lab, and even a music room to jam out in.
